nlcd-2021-land-cover.delivery: LIVE RASTER via MRLC WMS -- no GeoJSON file. The viewer consumes this layer live from the MRLC service; do NOT vectorise it into GeoJSON.
nlcd-2021-land-cover.configuration_notes: Viewer: add as a WMS tile overlay (e.g. Leaflet L.tileLayer.wms) pointed at service_url with layers=NLCD_2021_Land_Cover_L48, styles=mrlc_NLCD_Land_Cover, format=image/png, transparent=true, version 1.3.0, CRS EPSG:3857. Layer extent is CONUS (lon -130.23 to -63.67, lat 21.74 to 52.88); the service clips to the map view, so no watershed pre-clip is needed for display. Legend: GetLegendGraphic on the same service with layer + style above (advertised 261x509 px). 16-class Anderson Level II, 30 m raster. Change story 2001->2021: add one WMS layer per year from the same service (NLCD_{year}_Land_Cover_L48), or use the change layers in the same service: NLCD_2001_2021_Land_Cover_Change_Index_L48 and NLCD_01_21_Land_Cover_Change_Count. Offline/clipped raster (not the viewer path): WCS 2.0.1 GetCoverage on wcs_service_url with coverageId=mrlc_download__NLCD_2021_Land_Cover_L48. Subsetting REQUIRES subsettingCrs=http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326 plus subset=Lat(..)&subset=Long(..); bare Long/Lat subsets and x/y subsets in EPSG:5070 both fail with InvalidAxisLabel (verified 2026-11-21). Verified template: .../wcs?service=WCS&version=2.0.1&request=GetCoverage&coverageId=mrlc_download__NLCD_2021_Land_Cover_L48&subsettingCrs=http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326&subset=Lat(47.05,47.15)&subset=Long(-94.65,-94.55)&format=image/tiff -- returns a paletted GeoTIFF. Note: the WMS service also carries newer Annual NLCD layers (e.g. Annual_NLCD_LndCov_2024_CU_C1V1); the 2021 layer above is the synthesis deliverable -- do not silently substitute 2024. An Esri-hosted 'USA Legacy NLCD Land Cover' image service exists (ArcGIS item 3ccf118ed80748909eb85c6d262b426f) but was NOT tested live; MRLC is the primary source.
